cause: Upload handling unconditionally removed the category from missingDocuments, including from the refreshed authoritative application response, and ended loading before reconciliation.
changes: Required uploaded metadata must be active, security clean and review uploaded/pending_review/approved, matching backend inventory/submission rules.
Application refresh missingDocuments is retained without filtering out the uploaded category.
Upload remains busy through application reconciliation.
Optional documents do not block review when absent or awaiting a security scan.
limitations: No new browser or production verification of this security-gate change.
Previously recorded six browser reload cases predate this change.
Pending scan metadata currently requires a page reload to retrieve an updated status; no polling added.
